title: Swimmer drowning South Beach Skerries
description: Swimmer drowned at South Beach in shallow surf after rip formed near the groyne. NE wind 15kts, swell 1.4m, spring tide. RNLI Skerries recovered casualty.

title: Two teenagers swept off pier Skerries
description: Two teenagers swept off pier by wave. NE swell 1.6m, wind ENE 12kts, spring tide surge. Rescued by RNLI ILB.

title: Hypothermic swimmer rescued off Colt Island Skerries
description: Experienced sea swimmer Sean O'Kelly became severely hypothermic during a swim around Colt Island. He was found clinging to a rock, unable to move his arms or legs. Skerries RNLI reached him within minutes. Sea temperature was very cold; water temperature a key factor. Full account in RNLI magazine March 2017.

title: Paddleboarder carried offshore Skerries
description: Paddleboarder carried offshore in wind shadow eddy. NE 20kts, tide ebbing fast. Coast guard helicopter responded. Swell 1.0m.

title: Two swimmers caught in current at The Captains, Skerries
description: Dublin Coast Guard received a 999 call shortly before 17:00 that swimmers were shouting for help at The Captains swimming spot. Skerries RNLI launched and reached them within two minutes. A man and woman — experienced swimmers — had been caught by a current and were in the water for 40 minutes, cold and exhausted when rescued.

title: Woman blown out to sea in kayak off Skerries
description: Skerries RNLI rescued a woman who had been blown out to sea in a kayak. Offshore wind carried her beyond her ability to paddle back to shore.
